passives.name: Final Destination
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Damage dealt to Fire-element enemies is reduced and damage taken is increased, while damage dealt to Water-element enemies is increased and damage taken is reduced. Damage dealt greatly increases each time a unit is defeated.

buffs.summary: −50% damage to boss if attacker has element disadvantage

passives.name: Planet Terror
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, when all four enemy team members have same elements, increases damage taken. (Permanent) When granted increased Defense effect, greatly reduces damage taken. Every time inflicted with a debuff, grants increased Defense to the caster for [Buff_T_guild_raid_03_1_5_3] turn(s).
